ja: $500で　じしゃくの力を　見せてやろう

key: In life, there are many mysteries. But, sometimes, all you need is something simple, like a wall.
en: In life, there are many mysteries. But, sometimes, all you need is something simple, like a wall.
ja: 人生には　多くのなぞが　ある。だが　時には　壁のような　単純なもので　じゅうぶんなのだ

key: A simple discussion will run a simple $500.
en: A simple discussion will run a simple $500.
ja: 単純な講義は　単純に　$500だ

key: Ah, yes, the transmission of anxiety.
en: Ah, yes, the transmission of anxiety.
ja: ああ　そう　不安を　うつす　わざだな

key: I, too, find myself an insomniac, though I do not suffer for it!
en: I, too, find myself an insomniac, though I do not suffer for it!
ja: わたし自身も　ねむれぬ　たちだ。だが　それで　苦しんでは　おらんぞ!

key: I will request $1000 for this service.
en: I will request $1000 for this service.
ja: この講義には　$1000　いただこう

key: The joy of knowledge-- shared! Truly priceless.
en: The joy of knowledge-- shared! Truly priceless.
ja: 知識を　分かちあう　よろこび——まさに　値のつけられぬ　ものだ

key: Trainer! I do not wish to hold you, but before you depart, I must say something.
en: Trainer! I do not wish to hold you, but before you depart, I must say something.
ja: トレーナーよ! 引きとめる気は　ないが　去る前に　言っておきたいことが　ある

key: I am always available to converse once more with one who I have passed my knowledge onto.
en: I am always available to converse once more with one who I have passed my knowledge onto.
ja: 一度　知識を　さずけた相手とは　いつでも　また語りあおう

key: However, you will find that this is true even for those who do not share my love of learning!
en: However, you will find that this is true even for those who do not share my love of learning!
ja: しかも　これは　学問を愛さぬ者たちにも　当てはまるのだ!

key: Should you engage in such tutoring with anyone in the region, you will find that their services will be available to you after one transaction!
en: Should you engage in such tutoring with anyone in the region, you will find that their services will be available to you after one transaction!
ja: この地方の　誰かに　わざを教わったなら　一度の取引で　その後は　いつでも　教えてもらえる!

key: Please remember this when engaging in a similar arrangement with others in this region.
en: Please remember this when engaging in a similar arrangement with others in this region.
ja: この地方で　同じような　やりとりをするときは　覚えておきたまえ

key: Please return if there is more that I can share!
en: Please return if there is more that I can share!
ja: まだ語れることが　あるなら　また来たまえ!

key: Uggggggggh, those Lapis trustfund babies!
en: Uggggggggh, those Lapis trustfund babies!
ja: うぇぇぇぇ　ラピスの　お金持ちの　ぼんぼんども!

key: You know what I mean?!
en: You know what I mean?!
ja: わかるでしょ!?

key: Even if you somehow finally manage to get a leg up on their specially-tutored 5 IV bred Pokémon...
en: Even if you somehow finally manage to get a leg up on their specially-tutored 5 IV bred Pokémon...
ja: 特別に教えこまれた　個体値5つ最大の　ポケモンに　やっと　優位に立っても……

key: ...Then they just throw one of their five-bajillion Full Restores at it!
en: ...Then they just throw one of their five-bajillion Full Restores at it!
ja: ……山ほど持ってる　かいふくのくすりを　ポンと　使ってくるんだよ!

key: There's no winning against classism.
en: There's no winning against classism.
ja: 階級社会には　勝てないよ

key: We little people gotta take the W's where we can.
en: We little people gotta take the W's where we can.
ja: 庶民は　取れるところで　勝ちを　取るしかない

key: For instance, if someone asked me for a password, you know what I'd tell them?
en: For instance, if someone asked me for a password, you know what I'd tell them?
ja: たとえば　あいことばを　聞かれたら　なんて答えると　思う?

key: I'd tell them "stopitems".
en: I'd tell them "stopitems".
ja: 「stopitems」って　答えるね

key: That way, no enemy I ever face would ever be able to use a stupid Potion on their stupid Pokémon ever again!
en: That way, no enemy I ever face would ever be able to use a stupid Potion on their stupid Pokémon ever again!
ja: そうすれば　相手は　二度と　バカなポケモンに　バカなキズぐすりを　使えなくなる!

key: Hey, you're the one who was causing all that ruckus with Fern, right?
en: Hey, you're the one who was causing all that ruckus with Fern, right?
ja: ねえ　ファーンと　ひと騒動　起こしてた人　だよね?

key: Thanks for that, by the way, he really needed someone to show him his place.
en: Thanks for that, by the way, he really needed someone to show him his place.
ja: ありがとね。あいつには　身の程を　教えてくれる人が　必要だったんだ

key: It's a shame that the only thing people like him listen to is strength, but that's just how it is, I guess.
en: It's a shame that the only thing people like him listen to is strength, but that's just how it is, I guess.
ja: ああいう人は　強さにしか　耳を貸さない。残念だけど　そういうものなんだろうね

key: Like, I enjoy battling as much as the next person, but people here stake way too much of their self-worth on winning fights.
en: Like, I enjoy battling as much as the next person, but people here stake way too much of their self-worth on winning fights.
ja: わたしだって　バトルは　人並みに　好きだよ。でも　ここの人は　勝ち負けに　自分の値打ちを　かけすぎ

key: If you agree, maybe try telling the next person who asks you for a password "nobattles".
en: If you agree, maybe try telling the next person who asks you for a password "nobattles".
ja: 同じ考えなら　次に　あいことばを　聞かれたとき　「nobattles」と　答えてみて

key: It'll save you from having to defeat every person you meet in battle just so you can progress through things.
en: It'll save you from having to defeat every person you meet in battle just so you can progress through things.
ja: 先へ進むために　出会う人　全員を　倒す必要が　なくなるよ

key: And then you'll be free to focus on all the things that matter, like...
en: And then you'll be free to focus on all the things that matter, like...
ja: そうすれば　本当に大事なことに　集中できる。たとえば……

key: What were those, again?
en: What were those, again?
ja: えっと　なんだっけ?
